records.subject: Welcome aboard, Quartz Ventures
records.body:
Hi Ana,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no key milestone, and no reply to the welcome email [email:c93c9639]; zero tickets means no engagement signal at all. Accounts silent through the first week rarely self-activate in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: A quick hand with your first Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Ana,

Following up on my welcome note last week. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating that first project is really the step that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and once it's there you can invite your team from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through it with you and answer anything about how your team works.

Best,
Priya
